whenToUse: A CRM sales forecast: closed-won, commit and best case against quota for the quarter.
Pipeline reviews where managers scope the page by rep and move deals between stages.
avoidWhen: A general pipeline overview without quota tracking — use dashboard-02.
Working a single account in depth — use detail-04.
a11y: The forecast bar is role="img" with an aria-label; rep filter buttons expose aria-pressed.
Announce stage moves and their undo through a toast so the change is not visual-only.
